name: Mystery Road
description: When there is a mysterious disappearance on an outback cattle station, Detective Jay Swan is assigned to investigate. Working with local cop Emma James, Jay’s investigation uncovers a past injustice that threatens the fabric of the whole community.

videos.title: Gone
videos.overview: Detective Jay Swan clashes with local cop Emma James when he arrives to investigate the mysterious disappearance of two young men from an outback cattle station.

videos.title: Blood Ties
videos.overview: Two unannounced visitors in town cause chaos for Jay and Emma as they try to uncover what happened to the two missing young men.

videos.title: Chasing Ghosts
videos.overview: As time runs out to find the missing boys, pressure mounts on Shevorne to reveal what she knows.

videos.title: Silence
videos.overview: Marley's safe return has brought relief and elation to the town and his family – but where is Reese? And what is Marley hiding?

videos.title: The Waterhole
videos.overview: Reese's murder sends Jay on a desperate journey to clear Marley's name before it's too late, which leads Emma to uncover a far greater crime.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: In a race against time, Jay and Emma have to prove who really murdered Reese... or Marley will be gaoled for the crime.

videos.title: The Road
videos.overview: A decapitated body washes up in the mangroves, drawing Jay Swan to the furtive township of Gideon. It seems drug-related but is it also familiar? Partnered with local cop, Fran, Jay must unlock what the community knows.

videos.title: The Flare
videos.overview: Jay and Fran have Dylan on the hook, until a local businessman steps in and bails him out. Jay takes matters into his own hands to rectify the situation. Fran's world comes crashing down as a long-held fear suddenly surfaces.

videos.title: Artefacts
videos.overview: Struggling with Mary's new relationship, Jay reluctantly uses Simon's help to narrow in on the drugs and murder investigation. With the discovery of the bones, Fran is determined to reopen Zoe's case on her own.

videos.title: Broken
videos.overview: With the case apparently solved Jay is being encouraged to leave town, but something isn't adding up. Jay begins to question the motives of all those around him. Fran is dealt another blow in the search for justice for Zoe.

videos.title: To Live with the Living
videos.overview: Now in danger, Mary must lean into Jay for help. Jay struggles to keep Mary safe as the threat closes in on both of them. Fran feels betrayed as she digs deeper into Zoe's disappearance.

videos.title: What You Do Now
videos.overview: Jay is lured into a trap to rescue Mary and an epic gun battle erupts. Will Jay be able to survive this and serve justice? Fran finally gets answers about Zoe and some closure, but it won't be in the form she expects.
